text: The seawater intake and outfall pipelines shall be of HDPE or GRP with ballast weights and scour protection as required by ER-13.06 and designed for the 50-year wave condition Hs 4.4 m, Tp 8.5 s from the south-west (DP-OWNR-0020). The design flow is 38,000 m3/h (DEC-EPCE-0002); the intake velocity at the screens shall not exceed the EIA value (DP-EPCE-0011) and the water temperature range at the intake is 6 degC to 27 degC (DP-OWNR-0013, DP-OWNR-0012).
